name: Subtitle adverts
summary: Finds advert and credit lines in text subtitles
whatItDoes: Reads every text subtitle track in the file and looks for cues that match the patterns below — release-group credits, site adverts, "synced and corrected by" lines.
howItWorks: Each SRT or mov_text track is read with ffmpeg and every cue is matched against the patterns, without regard to case. A track with any match is flagged, with the first few matches listed.
ifDisabled: Subtitle adverts are not looked for.

raises.label: Subtitle adverts
raises.hint: A text subtitle track carries advert or credit lines.

patterns.label: Cues that count as adverts
patterns.help: Regular expressions, matched without regard to case, against each cue's text.
